games.title: Language Choice
games.description: Choose the form that makes the unit language accurate.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses the Past Continuous and the Past Simple together?
choices: I was eat lunch when she called.
They playing football when it rained.
She were cooking when the storm hit.
We were studying when the earthquake struck.
rounds.answer: We were studying when the earthquake struck.
rounds.explanation: Only this option pairs a correct Past Continuous (were studying) with a Past Simple (struck) after when.

rounds.prompt: Choose the correct connecting word: We stayed in the shelter _____ the storm passed.
choices: until
while
when
because
rounds.answer: until
rounds.explanation: Until shows an action that continues up to a stopping point, here the moment the storm passed.

rounds.prompt: What does the word 'capitalism' mean?
choices: A system where the government owns all property and shares it.
A formal statement announcing important news.
An economic system where people own businesses and compete to sell goods.
The process of using machines instead of people.
rounds.answer: An economic system where people own businesses and compete to sell goods.
rounds.explanation: Capitalism is a system of private ownership and competition, the model the story's country was leaving.
